method: Rubric for a reviewer reading a transcript of the skill at work; no model run is recorded here.

cases.prompt: 농장 마을을 three.js로 도트 느낌 3D 디오라마로 만들어줘.
must: render into a low-res target and enlarge by an integer factor with image-rendering: pixelated
outline from depth with a threshold that scales with the texel size
snap the camera target to the texel grid on the right and up axes only
measure draw calls before and after baking and instancing
report phone GPU performance as NOT_RUN unless a phone was used

cases.prompt: 카메라가 따라갈 때 건물 픽셀이 한 칸씩 지글거려.
must: name the missing texel snap as the cause
keep the low-res height instead of raising the resolution to hide it
stay read-only until the user asks for the fix
read renderer.info calls with autoReset off before changing anything
mark every node that changes after build as live before baking
skip rendering while the canvas is off screen and keep the simulation running
compare screenshots before and after so nothing that moved stands still
